name: esol
preregistration_note: Written after ESOL results existed: it transcribes the settings the ESOL runs already used (noise floor 0.6, MolLogP control, Delaney/Lovering baseline) so the pipeline reproduces them. Not a pre-registration.

source.citation: Delaney 2004, J. Chem. Inf. Comput. Sci. 44, 1000 (ESOL)

target_col: measured log solubility in mols per litre
noise_floor_source: ESOL logS experimental error is commonly quoted at ~0.5-0.7 log units; 0.6 was set in the original harness before any results.

control.name: lipophilicity
control.rationale: logS is dominated by lipophilicity; the ESOL equation's largest term is cLogP.

baseline.text: Molecules with LogP above the training median ({value:.2f}) are less soluble.
Molecules heavier than the training median ({value:.0f} Da) are less soluble.
Molecules with two or more aromatic rings are less soluble.
Molecules with sp3 fraction above the training median ({value:.2f}) are more soluble.
Molecules with at least one hydrogen-bond donor are more soluble.
